name: headline card stack breaks in beside a claim
looks: A numbered section label and a two-line bold claim sit at the left on a dark field; at the right, one news-style card (image, headline, source row) sits large with a live badge, and two more cards slide in and stack loosely beneath it in quick succession, each arriving a beat apart.
build: variant-stack-reveal: DOM cards enter on a short slide-and-settle (power3.out, 0.25-0.3 s) with a small seeded offset in x/y/rotation, staggered about 0.15 s apart; a pulsing "LIVE" dot uses provenance-glow-stroke's glow.
sound: A soft paper-slide whoosh per card, a quiet blip on the live dot.
prompt: Beside a short numbered claim, stack two or three content cards that slide in and settle one after another at a slight offset, topped by a pulsing live indicator. Let the arrival feel like a real-time feed updating, not a static layout.
